title: Readability: parse_date_to_ts fallback semantics undocumented
description: parse_date_to_ts in search/mod.rs returns 0 on parse failure. The fallback-to-0 behavior at line 112 lacks inline comment explaining why 0 is safe/acceptable as a sentinel value. For readers unfamiliar with Tantivy date filtering, it is not obvious that timestamp 0 won't collide with valid articles or break queries.
